name.text: 同一件事换成主动和被动
One Event in Active and Passive Voice

description.text: 同一件事，对照主动与被动，并看看现在、过去、将来怎么说。
Same event in active and passive, across present, past, and future.
用于比较同一件事写成主动还是被动时，句子焦点怎样变化。
Used to compare how the focus shifts when the same event is expressed in active or passive voice.

name.text: 过去 / 现在 / 将来视角

description.text: 语法宫格用的粗时间视角轴（past / present / future）。细时体与 will/going to 不进本维；时体对照走 grid，不建时体 paradigm。
Coarse time viewpoint axis for grammar grids (past / present / future). Fine tense forms and will/going-to live elsewhere; tense-aspect contrast uses grids, not paradigms.

description.text: 放在动词前，表达将来、能力、可能或必要。常见有 will / would / can / could / may / might / must / should，以及缩写。常见写法如 can、could、may、might、must、should、would、'd 等。例如 We will need two liters of water tomorrow.

Comes before the verb for future, ability, possibility, or necessity: will, can, must, should, and related forms. Common writings include can, could, may, might, must, should, would, 'd, and other matching forms. Example: We will need two liters of water tomorrow.

categoryDescription.text: 用于控制 can、will、must、should 等情态形式。

description.text: 构成被动。is / was / will be / is being 合在这一格，因为合起来才是被动谓语的完整时体，整块记，不要拆成 will 和 be、或 is 和 being。例如 The meeting is held every Monday. / The door will be opened tomorrow.

Passive be. is / was / will be / is being sit in one hole because together they are the passive predicate’s full tense-aspect — remember the chunk, don’t split will from be or is from being. Example: The meeting is held every Monday. / The door will be opened tomorrow.

categoryDescription.text: 用于控制 be、do、have、存在式或附加问句中的助动形式。
Controls auxiliary forms for be, do, have, existential frames, or tag questions.

description.text: 用来讲一般会做、习惯做或将要做的动作，不强调“正在进行中”。
For habitual, general, or future actions — not the sense of “in progress right now”.

Emphasizes an action in progress, unlike a general “what someone does”.

name.text: 说明某物是怎样被处理或发明的
Saying How Something Is Done or Invented

description.text: 说明某物怎样被处理、完成或发明，可以补上送到哪里、在何处、何时，以及 to do 的目的。
Say how something is done or invented. You can add where it is sent, where and when it happens, and a to-infinitive purpose.
